modules.title: 两个调度实例怎样避免同时执行同一任务
租约用时间限制持有权

items.title: 用续租和到期控制接管
items.text: 没有协调时，两个调度实例都可能开始每日汇总。取得租约后只有当前持有者执行并持续续租；它宕机或失联后，等待中的实例必须等租约过期才能取得新租约接管。

items.title: 改善要验证旧持有者风险
items.text: 每次成功接管都取得更大的持有代次，数据库或目标服务在写入时原子比较并拒绝旧代次。暂停 A 至租约过期，让 B 接管后再恢复 A，确认 A 的旧写入被拒绝。

items.title: 另一个场景：控制器选主
items.text: 多个控制器都能更新同一批资源状态时，可以用租约选出当前领导者并持续续租；领导者失联后由新实例接管，同时用新的持有代次阻止旧领导者继续提交变更。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 租约不是永久锁，也不是看到一次心跳延迟就可以立即接管。只在写入前查询一次当前持有者仍有检查后写入的时间差；要防止旧持有者，接收方必须在真正写入时原子校验递增持有代次，或使用等效的旧请求拒绝机制。

lessonPractice.title: 当前调度实例失联了，另一个实例准备运行同一任务。什么条件下可以接管？

options.label: 等原租约过期，再取得新租约和更大的持有代次；写入方原子拒绝旧代次
options.feedback: 对。到期决定何时可以接管；递增代次由真正接收写入的一方校验，才能挡住恢复后的旧实例。

options.label: 只要原实例没有主动释放，就永久等待它回来
options.feedback: 租约的意义就是让失联持有者最终失去持有权，永久等待会让任务无法恢复。

options.label: 不看租约状态，发现心跳暂时没到就立刻开始执行
options.feedback: 短暂网络延迟不等于租约过期，立即接管可能让两个实例同时执行。

en.title: The current scheduler is unreachable and another instance is ready to run the same job. When may it take over?

options.label: Confirm expiry, acquire a larger fencing token, and have the write target atomically reject stale tokens
options.feedback: Correct. Expiry permits takeover, while the monotonically increasing token lets the write target reject a recovered old holder.

options.label: Wait forever unless the old instance releases the lease itself
options.feedback: A lease lets an unreachable holder lose ownership eventually; waiting forever prevents recovery.

options.label: Ignore lease state and start as soon as one heartbeat is late
options.feedback: A short network delay is not expiry; immediate takeover can run the job twice.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 让每日汇总任务使用租约：实例先取得限时持有权并在执行期间续租。租约过期后，接管者取得一个更大的持有代次，也叫 fencing token（隔离令牌）。数据库或目标服务在写入汇总结果时，用同一个原子操作拒绝小于当前代次的请求。暂停实例 A 至租约过期，让 B 接管并写入，再恢复 A；验收 A 的旧代次写入被拒绝，最终只接受 B 的结果。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Use a lease for the daily summary job: an instance acquires time-limited ownership and renews it while running; after expiry, the new holder receives a larger fencing token. Make the database or target service atomically reject writes whose token is older than the current one. Pause instance A until expiry, let B take over and write, then resume A; verify that A's stale write is rejected and only B's result is accepted.

references.title: 使用 fencing token 防止过期持有者写入
references.title_en: Use fencing tokens to reject expired holders

learning.assumes: You know the same job can be triggered by multiple service instances.
learning.outcome: You can explain acquire, renew, expiry, and takeover, and require a monotonically increasing fencing token so the write target rejects stale holders.

modules.title: How two schedulers avoid running one job at the same time
A lease limits ownership by time

items.title: Control takeover with renewal and expiry
items.text: Without coordination, both schedulers can start the daily summary. A lease lets only the current holder run and renew ownership. If it fails or disconnects, a waiting instance must wait for expiry before acquiring a new lease and taking over.

items.title: Verify the old-holder risk
items.text: Each successful takeover receives a larger fencing token, and the database or target service compares it atomically when accepting a write. Pause A through expiry, let B take over, then resume A and verify that A's stale write is rejected.

items.title: Another case: controller leadership
items.text: When several controllers can update the same resources, a lease can elect the current leader and be renewed. After failure, a new controller takes over with a newer token so the old leader cannot keep submitting changes.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A lease is not a permanent lock, and one late heartbeat is not proof of expiry. Checking ownership before a write still leaves a check-then-write gap. To stop an expired holder, the write target must atomically validate a monotonically increasing fencing token, or use an equivalent stale-request rejection mechanism.

distinctions.label: Lock
distinctions.text: A standard {c:lock} requires explicit release and may deadlock on node crash; a {c:lease} adds TTL and heartbeat renewals for automatic failover.
